placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Canford Park suits a straightforward afternoon outside. Make time for the children's play area, then use the wider green space for a gentle walk and a breather before heading home.

Our family idea: bring a small snack and plan a short visit first. If everyone is happy, add another circuit of the park rather than feeling you need a full day of activities.
